pivotSpace: pixel-edge coordinates, origin at the bottom-left corner of one frame cell, x right, y up
frameLayout: one horizontal strip per clip; frame i occupies x = i*cell.w .. (i+1)*cell.w, full height; no padding

flip.note: flip once on the actor's parent (or its single renderer), same rule as art 03 / R02-R06

notProduced.shared-health / pair link art: not made on purpose: G3 actors have independent health, damage and kills (Core); no tether, joined outline or pair health bar
notProduced.left/right group marker or spawn effect: the left/right placement is Core's real spawn batch; no art marks the groups and no spawn effect is added
notProduced.invulnerability / disguise effect for G1: none: the mask changes expression only, and G1 is hit normally in every frame
notProduced.death / hit clips: not in the R07 brief; the existing shared enemy hit/death handling applies

assets.use: chase loop for ONE G3 actor: a single lean shadow runner with one swept horn on one side, one red eye and torn shadow cloth trailing. Each G3 actor is drawn alone with its own health; it is never drawn as a joined pair, twin bodies, a tether or a shared health bar. The 'two shades' are the two groups Core spawns on the left and right; Unity faces each actor toward its target with the parent flipX, so the two groups mirror each other (the single horn swaps side)
